focus.name: interaction-spawn-type5e-threshold-semantic
focus.purpose: Promote the bounded Type-0x5E threshold and adjacent Type-0x29/0x67 interaction handlers to stable creation identities while retaining selector-qualified historical names.

contracts: Selector 0xFB reverse-spawns the Type-0x5E interaction record when 0x00FF7E02 is at least 0x2646, installs MovementVM stream 0x0011F754, and clears 0x00FFF0E5 after allocation.
Selectors 0xC0-0xC7 and 0x57 reverse-spawn the established Type-0x29 interaction template; selector 0x3D forward-spawns the established Type-0x67 interaction template.
The handlers retain their exact selector multiplicity and allocation-helper contracts from the static evidence.
evidence: Exact 68000 handler bodies and INTERACTION_HANDLER_TABLE membership
Direct template loads, helper calls, selector-FB threshold compare, MovementVM literal, and cleanup write
limitations: The names identify runtime actor types and exact creation contracts, not user-facing object or scene roles.
The upstream lifecycle of the threshold and post-spawn cleanup bytes remains unresolved.
